title: plan-merge-delta
description: The EM-authored delta file a plan-merge op applies to N source plans. Declarative data only: every entry is applied mechanically, and no key admits code, an expression, or a free-form escape hatch. A drop with no reason, a new row with no anchor, an id or body rewrite, and a second `## Consolidation delta` section are unrepresentable.

sources.description: Ordered source plan paths. Source order is output order.

origin_label.description: Prefix applied to this source's carried prose sections.

spine_heading.description: The `## ` heading the source's spine fence sits under; passed through as the spine locator's heading hint. Defaults to `Tasks`.

frontmatter.description: The merged plan's own scalar frontmatter values, EM-chosen. Authorization and stamp keys are refused: each source's own stamp governs, and `status: approved` may not be asserted by a merge.

preamble.description: Literal Markdown for the merged plan's own H1 and intro, emitted before the first `## ` heading. A source's preamble is carried or declared dropped via the reserved heading `(preamble)` in `dropped_sections`.

rekey.description: Per-source id remapping. Required only when the op reports a cross-source id collision. Keys are source ids; values are merged ids.

rows.description: Per-row entries addressed by merged id (the post-rekey id). An existing row is edited by key block only; its id and body are never rewritten and `note` is the only way a body grows. A `new` row carries its own fields and body and an `after` anchor.

fields.description: Field -> new value. May not name `id` or `body`.

reason.description: Why the EM made this edit. Rendered in the op's `## Consolidation delta` table; never enters the row.

new.description: True when this entry adds a row that came from no source.

after.description: Merged id of the row a new row follows.

body.description: Body of a new row. Valid only with `new: true`.

dropped_sections.description: Sections the merge does not carry. Heading, source and reason are all required: a drop with no reason is unrepresentable. The reserved heading `(preamble)` names a source's pre-`## ` text.

new_sections.description: Sections the output adds that came from no source, in output order. Content is literal Markdown. The op renders `## Consolidation delta` itself, so that heading is refused here.
